banner.connected: LinkedIn osetudore. Leads iyudo sani - oboke ni loso bang’ thuolo matin.

connect.title: Tudi LinkedIn
connect.intro: Donji ka itiyo gi akaunt LinkedIn machung' ne lendo mari. Leadrat somo mana akaunt mari mag lendo, Lead Gen Form kod kwan mar lendo, kendo ooro lokruok ma iloso.
connect.need1: Tich e akaunt mar lendo LinkedIn (Janeno kata ma malo).
connect.need2: A role on the linked company page (Administrator, Lead Gen Forms Manager, Content Admin, Curator or Analyst) - LinkedIn requires it to share leads.
connect.need3: Penjo mar namba mar simu e Lead Gen Forms - jotelo ma onge namba mar simu ok nyal med.

connection.title: Tudruok
connection.autoRenews: Dwaro loso manyien owuon nyaka kindeno
connection.syncResult: Sync osetim: {{received}} oyudo, {{created}} olosi, {{duplicates}} oloso, {{rejected}} odagi.
connection.confirmDisconnect: Inyalo weyo tudruok LinkedIn ? Sink weyo kendo token mag donjo igoyo oko. Jotelo, kwan kod log mar gik ma itimo oketi.
connection.noPermission: Inyalo neno pejni. Mondo itud kendo ilok chenro, dwarore ni iyud ratiro mar "Rito chenro."
connection.fetchHint: Lead manyien ng’iyo bang’ dakika matin kendo ndalo 7 mogik ng’iyo kendo pile ka pile, omiyo onge gima ng’ato nyalo weyo. Ti kod wachni ne jogo ma ne odhi nyime gi tudruok, kata mondo irang’ kinde moro kendo (ma nyalo chopo ndalo 90 e kinde achiel). Gik ma osebedo e Leadrat iweyo.

capi.title: Conversions API
capi.intro: Wach ne LinkedIn ni en ng’ano kuom jotelo mage ma ne odoko geno adier. Ka ng’at ma otelo LinkedIn ochopo e rang’iny ma iyiero piny kae, Leadrat ogolo ripot ne LinkedIn , omiyo ripot mag kampen mari nyiso ng’at ma otelo kendo LinkedIn nyalo yudo ji mang’eny ma ohero jogo ma otelo maber moloyo. En mana ID mar jatelo LinkedIn kod hash mar yo achiel mar e-mail ema ooro.

capi.noRules: Onge rang’iny ma oseket e map nyaka sani.
capi.created: Loki ma olosi e LinkedIn kendo oketi map.
